svg.title: White Blue
svg.desc: Interpretive SVG study after an inspected primary museum photograph. Geometry approximate; interpretive screen colour not calibrated. Three observed blue regions on white rectangular ground, including lower-left curl and blue pointed area at right. Curves approximate. Palette refinement (2026-11-09): specific source-image review of blue, white; interpretive screen colors, not calibrated to original paint.
